source_edits.subject: name U+200C ZWJ and U+200D ZWNJ, as the release does
source_edits.body: The release names the glyph of U+200C (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) ZWJ and the glyph of U+200D (ZERO WIDTH JOINER) ZWNJ: the two names swapped relative to the characters, which the .vfb names correctly. Same outlines and advances; this reproduces the release's names, as an equivalent source must, and correcting them is a later change (tools/probes/upstream_main_2026-11-19/renames-layerfix-7ed09143.txt).
